Study plan

A six-week knowledge study plan

Combine official sources, concepts, scenarios and mixed review without displacing physical preparation.

Official sources checked: 2026-09-19

Weeks 1–2: role and law

Read the current Police pages and course plan. Build a glossary for appointment, authority, necessity, proportionality, reporting and confidentiality.

Weeks 3–4: communication and safety

Study conflict reduction, emergency care, fire, CBRNE and the work environment. For every scenario, name the hazard, first safe step and handover.

01ASSIGNMENT02AUTHORITY03PROPORTION04REPORT

Week 5: intervention and report

Connect legal authority to reassessment, observation and factual documentation. Physical techniques belong in instructor-led training.

Week 6: mixed checks

Complete timed mixed sets, analyse errors and return to the official source. Keep separate preparation for the 2-kilometre run and dummy drag.

Official sources

Use this material for structure and review. Current Swedish Police law, training and operational instruction always control.
